extension.summary: Synchronised Plex playback with friends in PM4K
extension.description: Watch Party synchronises Plex playback in PM4K across devices, so friends in different places can watch together. Start a watch party and invite people: playback starts, pauses and skips for everyone at the same time. Requires a Watch Party server and a connection code from its administrator.
extension.news: v0.3.11 - A new menu: wider, the same on every skin, with where you stand at the top, each option's setting on the right and an explanation of the selected option at the bottom. Do not disturb switches right in the menu. v0.3.10 - After a skip, a device that lands precisely (a computer) lines up once more if it ended up a little off from the others. Devices that land less precisely, like most TVs, are left as they are. - Works together with devices that have not updated yet: checked before every release. - A setting changed in the menu just as Watch Party connects (such as Do not disturb) is no longer missed.

extension.description: Install this once. Kodi then keeps Watch Party up to date by itself.
